name: Nick Dodson
description:
Nick is the CEO of Fuel Labs Inc. and is the builder behind Fuel, the first Optimistic Rollup on Ethereum Mainnet. A long-time Ethereum community member and a Solidity first user. Nick has presented multiple times at DevCon on topics from decentralized crowdfunding to DAO governance.

Fuel Labs is now working across a spectrum of layer-2 technology and AI.
